purpose: Risk-driven SOLVA fitness testing. Test coverage expands with capabilities and discovered failure modes; no arbitrary pass-count target.
principles: untested capability is not production capability
every discovered failure becomes a regression case
authority never increases because intelligence increases
a claimed business outcome requires evidence
promotion_rule: Do not promote a capability when critical failure modes remain FAIL or materially unresolved UNKNOWN.
continuous_rule: On every material capability, policy, connector, model, or runtime change: identify new failure modes, add tests, execute relevant regression suites, and record evidence before promotion.
